body:
Abortion is on the ballot in Ohio this year.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48921616/360115978/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODU1ZjJhMS1iMjE2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6BnVlEyLj09e0HzT-hL-m5ZimS0bgNBLTbx29sIh7NA=)

Team,

**Ohio is a pro-choice state:** A majority of Ohioans want abortion to be legal, and want our government to protect the full range of reproductive care.

But Mike DeWine and the Republican legislature here in Ohio are doing the exact opposite. The same day the Supreme Court overturned _Roe,_ Republicans implemented a six-week abortion ban with no exception for rape or incest, and they’re pushing hard to criminalize it altogether.

**This isn’t what Ohioans want – so when I’m governor, I’ll support a ballot measure to protect abortion access in the Ohio Constitution because we need to let Ohioans, not extreme right-wing politicians, decide on our own health care.**

**[If you join me in supporting the right to safe, legal abortion, chip in to my campaign right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48921617/360115989/1463509703?refcode=nw_em_220807_1_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODU1ZjJhMS1iMjE2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6BnVlEyLj09e0HzT-hL-m5ZimS0bgNBLTbx29sIh7NA=)**

With politicians like Mike DeWine and his friends running the show in Columbus right now, an amendment to protect reproductive freedom is the best way to restore abortion rights in Ohio and ensure that personal decisions like these are being made by people, not politicians.

Hello,
Growing up in rural Iowa, I thought we were well-to-do because we had a piano, a well-used sewing machine, a big garden, and a flag pole. Our house was small, one bathroom, for a family of ten. I was surprised to know that not every family struggled with affording the $7 meal ticket each kid needed for school.
Lebanon, Iowa, had eight houses, a church, and a small feed store. My life centered on helping my dad, school, and exploring Dry Creek, a wonderland of aquatic life down the hill. The nearest town was Hudson, SD, nine miles west down a gravel road.
We were the prototypical rural Iowa family. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, lunch, then supper kept the house full of aromas. “Read a book,” would be mom’s terse direction if you showed any idleness. It is from this humble beginning, work as a welder, farmhand, then in a slaughterhouse, that brought me into the U.S. Navy.
America must present an opportunity for its citizens to achieve great things. From homemade clothes (I’m the littlest one) to a three-star Admiral is just one such journey. The next step is to use life’s experiences to continue a lifetime of service to this nation and my state of Iowa.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa because I can represent people from all walks of life. My life’s experiences provided an innate understanding for what it means to be a Democrat:_to care as much for those I’ve never met as I do for those I know_. Obviously, Chuck Grassley is not a Democrat; he seems to only care about what Trump and his corporate PAC donors want.**
People like me aren’t supposed to be able to run and win. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are already raising millions from corporate special interests to try to make sure I don’t.
If there’s one thing I’ve learned in life, though, it’s that anything is possible when a group of people work together to make it happen. I’m not taking one dime from corporate PACs; instead, I’m running my campaign entirely with support from over 122,000 grassroots donors like you.
[**So please, if you’re able to, will you consider making a donation to my campaign today to help me defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue? Lebanon, Iowa, had eight houses, a church, and a small feed store. My life centered on helping my dad, school, and exploring Dry Creek, a wonderland of aquatic life down the hill. The nearest town was Hudson, SD, nine miles west down a gravel road. We were the prototypical rural Iowa family. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, lunch, then supper kept the house full of aromas. “Read a book,” would be mom’s terse direction if you showed any idleness. It is from this humble beginning, work as a welder, farmhand, then in a slaughterhouse, that brought me into the U.S. Navy. America must present an opportunity for its citizens to achieve great things. From homemade clothes (I’m the littlest one) to a three-star Admiral is just one such journey. The next step is to use life’s experiences to continue a lifetime of service to this nation and my state of Iowa. I’m running for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa because I can represent people from all walks of life. My life’s experiences provided an innate understanding for what it means to be a Democrat:to care as much for those I’ve never met as I do for those I know. Obviously, Chuck Grassley is not a Democrat; he seems to only care about what Trump and his corporate PAC donors want. People like me aren’t supposed to be able to run and win. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are already raising millions from corporate special interests to try to make sure I don’t. If there’s one thing I’ve learned in life, though, it’s that anything is possible when a group of people work together to make it happen. I’m not taking one dime from corporate PACs; instead, I’m running my campaign entirely with support from over 122,000 grassroots donors like you. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I’m running for Senate to represent the people of Iowa – all of the people of Iowa – not special interests or corporations. But I need your help now if I’m going to be able to fight back against all of Chuck Grassley and Mitch McConnell’s attacks and win. Thank you so much for being a part of this campaign, Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.) name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Florida Strikes Back Against the Woke Mob
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=43b46efa4b719e203d7da31b5d46f0f5c8d222ee00271d62be37c399b7743aba974eabaa05e59aa108790822f52270a73e3abc0018a59e1e99d8686fd0b0beb8a8a81b64d1f8c51d047415fa0b831f4d

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=eef070348a011792b86631881a907cde90ef352cd2701f478d83145f828d13011e930fac58e8f68a67a1461db64e6b84650bda1c66b4e468

Peter,

Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We’ve seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people.

The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will.

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don’t let its banal name fool you — it’s a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it’s not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=eef070348a011792b86631881a907cde90ef352cd2701f478d83145f828d13011e930fac58e8f68a67a1461db64e6b84650bda1c66b4e468
>>">PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE >>>

The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company who dares to defy them.

And it’s working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They’re going woke. And the consequences are dire.

As Governor, I’m making sure we fight back. This isn’t just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of Left-wing activists who couldn’t run a lemonade stand.

We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left’s agenda. Now, in Florida, we’ve prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida’s money based on political factors.

We want them to invest the state’s money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida’s retirees. That’s what the people of Florida deserve.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=eef070348a011792b86631881a907cde90ef352cd2701f478d83145f828d13011e930fac58e8f68a67a1461db64e6b84650bda1c66b4e468
>>">AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE >>>
But we didn’t stop there. We also took aim at one of the Left’s favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That’s right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don’t like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don’t agree with from being able to buy and sell goods.

That’s not happening in Florida. I’m not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism.

These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn’t stopped the Left from attacking me. That’s why I had to write you today.

The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they’ve gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we’re doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes – successes that look like common sense to average Americans – as the radical position.

I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That’s why I need your help. That’s why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob.

Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years.
- Fighting the Fauci fanatics.
- Keeping kids in schools and businesses open.
- Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most.
- Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel.
The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office.

No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down.

I hope you’ll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=eef070348a011792b86631881a907cde90ef352cd2701f478d83145f828d13011e930fac58e8f68a67a1461db64e6b84650bda1c66b4e468
I hope you’ll be there with me to fight back.

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=eef070348a011792b86631881a907cde90ef352cd2701f478d83145f828d13011e930fac58e8f68a67a1461db64e6b84650bda1c66b4e468

| ,

I’m sure you’ve heard the resounding rumor - Newsom isn’t just running for re-election as Governor. He’s prepping for his presidential run.

In fact, Fox News recently released an article detailing 6 reasons why Newsom would make a horrible president [(you can check that out right here if you want).](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=3550138cb0&e=f9133ea432)

But ultimately, the reason his presidency would be a disaster is simple: Gavin Newsom has a track record of solving **absolutely nothing. **

Time and time again, Newsom has a history of making problems worse either by his own policies, his fight for extreme policies, and/or his failures in leadership.

In that article, Fox News resounded points that this campaign has been telling Californians for months, including the facts that...
* **He refuses to allow CA to become energy independent**
* **He has sunk CA to #1 in the country in poverty**
* **He can’t solve our homelessness problem**
* **He does nothing as crime rates spiral out of control**
* **He ignores our rising drug-related health crisis**
* **He refuses to enforce forest management to reduce wildfires**
* **He won’t build new water storage to prepare for droughts**

And that’s just to name a few.

Meanwhile, his campaign slogan is “California is leading the way.”

**California is clearly not leading the way. **

Instead, he is failing Californians at every turn.

If you hear one thing from me today, hear this:

Californians DO NOT need to live in a constant state of crisis.

There are practical solutions to each of these issues we are facing.

As we near the finish line (less than 100 days from the election), can you help me swiftly implement these solutions?

I need your help with our final fundraising push to spread our message of hope to all Californians.

Can you do your part to chip in?

It was a long, sleepless weekend, but it sure feels good to wake up this morning knowing that we passed something that will make a real difference for American seniors, families, and workers — and put our country on the path to being a global leader in the fight to combat climate change and transition to a new clean energy-based economy.
This was no small feat. Because not a single Republican would join us in this cause, we needed every single one of our 50 Senate Democratic votes — plus Vice President Kamala Harris — to pass this bill. It also establishes a 15% minimum tax to ensure that big corporations can no longer get away with making massive profits but paying zero taxes.
Medicare recipients will see lower costs for prescription drugs. Millions of American families will see lower health care premiums. It will spur growth in good-paying clean energy jobs. And much more.
This win shows the American people what's possible when you have the votes in the U.S. Senate. That's exactly why we need to go all out in the 2022 elections to increase Democratic seats in the now 50:50 Senate and maintain our majority in the House of Representatives.

**The bottom line is: Elections are about choices. And those choices are clearer than ever at this moment. Yesterday, every Democrat supported this important step forward for the country. And every Republican opposed it.**
Meanwhile, Republicans around the country are passing extremist laws to outlaw abortion, even in cases of rape and incest, and criminalize doctors who try to save the lives of women experiencing life-threatening medical emergencies.
We need to make sure every Marylander and every American knows what’s at stake this November and gets out to vote.
92 days to Election Day — and we need to make every day count!
Onwards,
Chris

| Friend,
In 2012 when Superstorm Sandy hit New Jersey, I saw first-hand devastation. Not only in my own neighborhood but throughout the state. When my community came together, it inspired me to leave my job in healthcare to serve my hometown first.
After 30 years in the healthcare industry as a nurse and then as a VP in National Sales and Marketing, I took the first step to support a future for my children, grandchildren, and everyone in New Jersey. In 2014, I ran and won my first race as a Township Committeewoman, then was elected as Deputy Mayor, then-Mayor, to Monmouth County Freeholder, and continued onward to Deputy Director of the Freeholder Board.
I know how to win!
But after this past year, where we have had the highest inflation in over 40 years, gas prices that have risen over a dollar in a single year, supply chain disruptions, an administration that doesn't support our law enforcement, failed open border policies that have allowed drugs to flood into our country, and mandates that have destroyed our small businesses, I knew something had to change.
THAT IS WHY I AM RUNNING FOR CONGRESS
People are not happy with the direction of the country; it's a fact. Career politicians Frank Pallone and Joe Biden have done nothing to help our Great State and it's time for a change.

name: American Update
subject: Victor Davis Hanson on DVD
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0592%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=tU4TfgOrPn9unXkxYztbkQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30712%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=K6QFsV%2b%2fK1E%2fGWLlzIwSXQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30713%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4Ss2rrujL4R7VkqjQAiYyA&sysid=1) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c30714%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PQEA0%2fAxroD47uYSWwmYlQ&sysid=1)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=c3d175eb9e&e=00028e5542)
[**James Judge wins Tampa Republican Primary Poll in Landslide with 77 percent of votes**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=be58c9f7aa&e=00028e5542)
_The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary, James Judge, dominated his two primary opponents in an online poll conducted by the Tampa Bay Young Republicans last week._ TAMPA, Fla. – James Judge won [the Tampa Bay Young Republicans primary poll](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=11939df587&e=00028e5542) with nearly 77 percent of the votes cast, the Judge campaign said Monday. The poll was conducted among more than 400 members of the Tampa Bay Young Republicans, who are aged 18-40 and will likely vote in the Aug. 23 primary election.Judge raked in 76.79% of the vote, compared to a combined 23.22% between his two primary opponents who are also on the ballot. One of those opponents, [Jerry Torres, was recently found to be disqualified ](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=d926cdc989&e=00028e5542)by a Tallahassee Judge, though his name will still appear on the ballots as they had already been printed.The poll also showed Republican State House Candidate for District 65, Jake Hoffman, winning his primary in a landslide. Hoffman earned 84.51% of the vote.In Florida State House District 65, Republican Danny Alvarez had a commanding lead over his primary opponent. He received 81.82 percent of the vote.“I am humbled and honored to see our hard work on the campaign trail paying off in polls like this. The Tampa Bay Young Republicans’ poll reflects the momentum we’ve gained headed into the primary election, and I am so very grateful to all of those volunteering and helping with my campaign,” said Judge. “I genuinely appreciate the strong showing of support among the Tampa Bay Young Republicans and all my future constituents in the district. I’d also like to thank the TBYR for conducting the poll.”Judge has long been described as the “frontrunner” in the primary election, and the TBYR poll confirms that descriptor.As Judge engages with the community, meets more voters, and obtains more endorsements, his campaign continues to pick up steam.Judge recently earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times, and has been endorsed by legendary Republican strategist Roger Stone, Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.Judge also plans on announcing more high-profile endorsements later this week.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

subject: Your health care matters more than special interest profits.

body:
Team, I’ve mentioned before that I’m proudly running for re-election on my record. So I want to talk to you a bit about one of the most important issues we’ve tackled here in Colorado: making health care more affordable.

Team, I’ve mentioned before that I’m proudly running for re-election on my record. So I want to talk to you a bit about one of the most important issues we’ve tackled here in Colorado: making health care more affordable. **Look, no one — _no one_ — should ever have to choose between losing their life savings or losing their life. That belief is one of the biggest reasons I ran for Governor, and it’s why this issue has been a central priority of our administration.** We even started a focused effort, headed by our terrific Lieutenant Governor, Dianne Primavera, called the Office of Saving People Money on Health Care. (It’s not catchy, but it’s straightforward!) Making progress has not always been easy. We’ve gone up against special interests who had huge profit incentives to keep the system rigged against patients. **But by working together, we’ve made changes that are making a real difference in Coloradans’ lives:**
* We capped the price of insulin at $100 per month — so that folks with diabetes don’t have to fork over huge amounts of money to get life-saving medication.
* We cracked down on surprise out-of-network hospital billing.
* We passed major reforms to our insurance system that are reducing premiums across the state by over 24%.
* We’ve worked to make affordable mental health care more accessible for all Coloradans — especially our kids.

As I’ve said to you before, if any political candidate is going to ask you for their support, they need to tell you what they stand for. **So let me be very clear: I will always stand for putting the wellbeing of Colorado families before the profits of special interests. And I will keep fighting to save people money on their health care costs, because there is a lot more work to do — so that no one has to stare down bankruptcy just because they or a loved one had the misfortune to get sick.** **If that’s a value you share, and you’d like to support our campaign, I’d be truly grateful for any help you can provide us. Here is a secure link if you’re able to pitch in:[secure.actblue.com/donate/jared-polis](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48951970/360222489/907196865?refcode=email_080822_Yourhealthcarematters&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Njc5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODkwY2JkMC0zZDE3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xvmqF1Xwq1BkFJ7cS0iguojkLY8PS6jE4AdLQB8Mgq4=)** Thank you for taking the time to read this email, friend, and for being a part of this team. I don’t take it for granted, and I’m truly grateful. Jared

Fellow American,

We are officially ONE day from the most important Primary of the cycle – and Pelosi is sweating bullets, desperate to cling to power and keep my radical opponent in Congress.

**The Queen of Lockdowns decided that YOU were not essential - and then she turned around and broke her own rules when it suited her. **

---
These policies were cruel, and they did NOTHING to protect public health and safety.
---
It’s been a long four years, but this November, we _finally_ have a chance to hold her accountable. We can _finally_ bring America First leadership to Michigan and get our state back on track.

**[_CONTRIBUTE TO FIRE WHITMER >>_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64246%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cdtF3NmAoffTeVVGAWQI2A&sysid=1)**

Whitmer is cheering every disastrous Biden policy that has plunged us into a recession.

She’s driven the price of groceries through the roof. And that’s just for the groceries you can actually find on the shelf! Baby formula? Who needs it, right?

---
_This comes at a time when the average gas price in Michigan is well over $4 a gallon!_
---
When Whitmer finally reopened our schools, she poisoned our children’s minds with crazy left-wing anti-American ideas like critical race theory and radical gender theory.
---
She doesn’t want parents to have any say in their children’s education!
---
Whitmer has embraced the “spirit” of the defund-the-police movement, even as violent crime in Michigan increases at DOUBLE the rate of the national average.
---
She’s happily put the safety of our communities in jeopardy to appease her far-Left base!
---
With a track record like that, you’d think her defeat would be assured in November...
---
_... but national Democrats are desperate to keep control of this key swing state. _
---
_They know it could decide the 2024 elections, so they want to make sure they have a far-Left puppet who can put her finger on the scales to hurt President Trump and swing the election towards Democrats._
---
That’s why they’ve poured millions of dollars into Michigan to prop up Whitmer. She’s currently sitting on a war chest of over $14.7 MILLION, and she’s going to spend every penny of it to try to torpedo our surging campaign.
---
We need to be prepared for an onslaught of lying attack ads, and we need to secure the funds to FIGHT BACK. That’s where you come in, Friend.
---

**[_HELP US FIGHT BACK >>_](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64247%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8X2MUndLhB5uvwP4nMGeUA&sysid=1)**
---

I know you’re a patriot who supports President Trump, Ron DeSantis, and other conservative leaders.
---
You believed in them and helped them win tough battles when no one thought it was possible.
---
Now, I need you to help me win what will be one of the toughest battles in the country this November.
---
I know something about tough battles. This primary was a tough fight. Fighting and beating breast cancer was a tough fight. Running and growing a Michigan-based steel company, as a woman, was tough. Watching my Nana locked away and left to die in a nursing home was tough.
---
_But as the saying goes, when the times get tough, the tough get going. I am tough, and I am just getting going._
---
With America First patriots like YOU fighting alongside me, we’re going to take back our state from the radical Left and lay the groundwork to take back the White House in 2024.
---
The battlelines in this race couldn’t be any clearer. This is going to be an epic fight between a conservative businesswoman and mother, and a far-Left birthing parent and career politician.
---
**_To win, I’m going to need your support, Friend. I don’t have liberal megadonors like Whitmer. Grassroots conservatives like you are all I’ve got._**

name: Pete Sepp
subject: All the spending hikes in the legislation will increase the deficit!
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60959842:JkP7PpVNH:m:1:3253819041:8437C934A105E3D9373BA3344B5C2BE8:r)
Peter,

A $300 billion reduction in the federal budget deficit over the next ten years sounds like a good thing, right?

Unfortunately, the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) is unlikely to do as its name implies.**In fact, the government 's own budget scorekeeping agency just reported that the deficit reduction won't even begin until 2027 -- until then, all the spending hikes in the legislation actually make the deficit worse! **

But that hasn't stopped Democrats from trying to rush this bill through Congress.

Let me introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). Since our founding in 1969, our mission is to achieve practical policy wins to improve the lives of taxpayers, using the most effective team on Capitol Hill and in the states. We've won many victories in reducing taxes, stopping wasteful spending programs, and protecting your rights as a taxpayer.

Peter, NTU is voicing our concerns over this act. Will you help us lobby on behalf of taxpayers?

[_**Please support NTU 's efforts by donating $25, $50, $100, or any amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60959842:JkP7PpVNH:m:1:3253819041:8437C934A105E3D9373BA3344B5C2BE8:r)

Over 10 years, the IRA is projected to reduce the deficit by $300 billion, but the details show this is highly unlikely.

Based on the timing of the new spending and taxes in the bill, it's almost certain that _the IRA would spend more than it saves_ in the early years.

Any front-loaded deficits will increase interest payments on the national debt.

**Each $100 million increase in spending in 2023 adds another $27 million to debt interest costs over the decade.**

The legislation would also give the Internal Revenue Service more funds for enforcement -- claiming to target high earners who are _" tax cheats." _

After 34 years at NTU, working on five separate IRS reform bills, I can tell you that this enforcement ploy doesn't meet rosy revenue projections - but it does often lead to due process violations for Americans up and down the income ladder.

[_**NTU is working on voicing taxpayer concerns against this bill. Your urgent donation will benefit our lobbying efforts. Click here to show your support >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60959842:JkP7PpVNH:m:1:3253819041:8437C934A105E3D9373BA3344B5C2BE8:r)

If Congress was serious about fighting inflation, they could take action like clawing back the massive spending hikes enacted in 2021 now taking effect, and increasing energy supplies to stabilize prices.

Then there's making the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act permanent. NTU led a coalition to pass this landmark tax reform bill in 2017. Since then, the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act has generated economic growth. With a recession potentially on the horizon, Americans need to be able to count on moderate tax bills going forward.

Instead, Congress is attempting to pass a bill filled with recycled bad policy ideas that will unlikely have any significant impact on inflation.

That's why I need your help, Peter. Please help NTU lobby against short-sighted policies like the Inflation Reduction Act by clicking below.

Friend, Marco Rubio is attacking my 27 years of law enforcement service, so I'm reaching out to set the record straight.

Back in 1983, **I answered a call to serve because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm.** And while I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician.

But the problem is that some voters have only heard Marco Rubio's lies about me, and I need the resources to share my story of service with more Floridians before it's too late. Please understand, friend: How quickly I'm able to correct the record for voters will make or break this election.

I was one of few women in a class of 30 when I joined the police academy – but I always remembered what my mom had told me: "Be the best you can be, even if people say you don't belong."
And when it came time to choose a class president, one of the other women in our class convinced me to run. I was nervous, but I went for it – and I won by a landslide.
**I graduated not only as class president but at the top of my class.** When I got out of the academy, I went straight to work protecting and serving my community. And after decades of service, **I became the first Black woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.**
Fast-forward to today: I'm about to take on my biggest challenge yet. There are obstacles ahead, but with my "never tire" attitude and a massive grassroots movement behind me, I know that I can become Florida's next U.S. senator and expand our Democratic Senate majority.

**[If you're on my side, please donate $5 or whatever you can right now to help me share my story with more voters and defeat Marco Rubio.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48952894/360226069/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3978-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMWZhNmZiYi0zZjE3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=es8ZtT_Gf6qI3cHKln0o4kaQlGHUPEXW27qEYkSeswY=)**

**I'm no stranger to adversity, friend. If naysayers like Rubio think their attacks will make me feel defeated, they've got another thing coming. I've heard it all before – and I've only come out stronger.**
Thank you for joining this grassroots movement.

Chief Val Demings

Peter, Democrats - including my opponent - have told me I’m “white adjacent” and “extremist” because I don’t meet the narrative of an oppressed minority immigrant who craves unlimited handouts.

My family escaped communist Vietnam and came to America as legal refugees. My parents took every opportunity that was given to them to make a life for their family. My father even took a job that only allowed him to see us every six months.

It was hard, but my parents’ grit and determination inspired me to push myself to the limit and seek every opportunity this great country had for me. I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and served in the Navy as a Special Operations Officer.

My time in the Navy was incredible - but it was also challenging. I diffused bombs in places like Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. I dove into treacherous waters to salvage the remains of fallen soldiers.

_But no matter where I went, I brought my most prized possession - my American flag - with me._

I looked to that flag for strength. It was a reminder of everything our great country had achieved, and everything we were going to in the future. But with Joe Biden abandoning our troops in Afghanistan and rolling out the red carpet for the Taliban, he put a stain on our flag that I could not take in vain.

Politics was never my dream or goal. Standing shoulder to shoulder with my brothers and sisters and arms and raising a family in the greatest nation on Earth was all I ever wanted. But just because I hung up my Naval uniform doesn’t mean I was done looking out for my fellow soldiers.

I knew that with the Commander in Chief abandoning them, I had to serve them in a new capacity: as a member of Congress.

Politics is a whole different beast. Instead of dismantling Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs), I’m fighting off keyboard warriors who want to shame me for unapologetically loving our country.
But I have one request for my opponents who want to erase my heritage and divide our citizens by the color of their skin: instead of calling me “white adjacent” or “extremist” because I believe in the Constitution, all I ask is that you call me an American. Because I know I’ve earned it.

[**If you’re ready for a new generation of conservative leadership in Congress, I hope you’ll stand with me today and bring our country together under the greatest flag in the world.**](http://links.hungforcongress.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=11c0eb8094a34770af3a78be07bdb6ff&_e=kdFpVxvrTYStwGLmm_OPz3c73V6O5yC1cNSccZwnLRaguE3RXAojvgVeApDrj33qHfyyy7DUOr1z-jfIgVOE15WQUTJZA-jQGjrhOu74Z4wC-5qkB9vxHM5eDTIvdqjSEG45yxgdB-ssjZBn1zzcpZiYKESq7w2Tdh-LMhyMnyTUttzynKERzHal6m3XBVQXKGfrrDzbPxNlpOqK7tb-t1Z4zfVaEiVwHvwTwlOq2E4tdCNMPE2TKO4Dpi4Hr3LkYJsewsOSq89u3pvI4SGdt7yTQwEltUcVjl4T7iY4oj7wiAN-WLCCN8lNWpj_PTEvw-xd-curCcGnqJ4pEZoZ3lvujzO9mfsKdilyuOwQiMXPL2tVXVLyPmPwu-akLuI3i477Vxb9s7aM6wVnAH4n5U0lXHEUuVet8vGGgF3V7F4%3D)

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MONDAY, AUGUST 8
ICYMI: ALBANY HERALD PROFILES KELLY LOEFFLER'S JOURNEY FROM U.S. SENATE TO GREATER GEORGIA (ATLANTA) - In case you missed it, The Albany Herald featured a Sunday edition [interview](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YwcIuJBKrx-v0Z3yGVcc23CPPMnBeIyMCWaG640tRqxQyy7JTs6MVhpXX31d6ouTZbQIaQlGNv6Dje-GyNe8gksvVW9NXJ7xh5OemPeixcaQk2HqOPgmM88Nuur2d4kXCL8rU1yppC9-jG7cdSi5r0De-GxuwTt_xuk9j7QuHhtQvRJeWfQ8atMU7M4eGPoW5RZmxr8w2_FTiWvKVIo_Weg4eyKYy1-AT2yZ4Aofu09w5DhWBVRQCGTx1nYVGs0kt8qlUiGbDRTZIRkWVB6RTGH7mm3EfI7TCkB2xiZEvc13k61JW8gpHbr6RPVapepz&c=nSVUJ-TXWFgLXkHKVhPMBscPnZsUNbEuaFaImN2ms-7zMuextg89Rw==&ch=XCgP54IZMnJ9OdeI57LqqSLX37H4sTPdsNBT2PGS5UHy5NJ6G4TMWw==) with Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. She discusses her journey from serving in the U.S. Senate, to taking the lessons from the 2020 election, to bootstrapping Greater Georgia outside an election year - helping grow Georgia's conservative movement and mobilizing voters at a critical time.
You can read the full article by clicking [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YwcIuJBKrx-v0Z3yGVcc23CPPMnBeIyMCWaG640tRqxQyy7JTs6MVhpXX31d6ouTZbQIaQlGNv6Dje-GyNe8gksvVW9NXJ7xh5OemPeixcaQk2HqOPgmM88Nuur2d4kXCL8rU1yppC9-jG7cdSi5r0De-GxuwTt_xuk9j7QuHhtQvRJeWfQ8atMU7M4eGPoW5RZmxr8w2_FTiWvKVIo_Weg4eyKYy1-AT2yZ4Aofu09w5DhWBVRQCGTx1nYVGs0kt8qlUiGbDRTZIRkWVB6RTGH7mm3EfI7TCkB2xiZEvc13k61JW8gpHbr6RPVapepz&c=nSVUJ-TXWFgLXkHKVhPMBscPnZsUNbEuaFaImN2ms-7zMuextg89Rw==&ch=XCgP54IZMnJ9OdeI57LqqSLX37H4sTPdsNBT2PGS5UHy5NJ6G4TMWw==), or read a few quotes below:

| "Georgia is not just a large state, it is a diverse state. We're talking to people, knocking on doors, rebuilding the party's infrastructure. We're out there talking to black, Latino and Asian voters, to women's groups. Part of our mission is to educate voters, to help them understand the issues and where the people they're asked to vote for stand on those issues. Because an engaged voter is a more empowered voter." ...
"This is a great opportunity for our party. The other side is pushing this concept of a 'green economy,' and that's nothing more than a fallacy. Instead of working to make things better, they're selling this green utopia that's not happening. So we get these high gas prices, high food costs, an economy that's making it tough for people to make a living.
"We have the pieces in place: the data, the resources, the manpower ... the infrastructure. It's a matter of working that ground game, knocking on those doors, making those calls, sending those texts. Right now, this is what I'm called to do. I experienced a setback, a failure in my campaign. But you learn more from failure than you do success. I'm taking what I learned and putting it to good use."

There are just three months left until the election, folks, and I couldn't be more grateful for the grassroots support we've received.
Month after month, you've helped us hit our fundraising goals and connect with voters across the state.

Thanks to your support, we had a strong July, but things are now slowing to a crawl.
Historically, campaigns see an uptick in donations after Labor Day. But we can't wait that long. Once September gets here, we'll find out who our Republican opponent is, enter the final month of the fundraising quarter, and head into the final stretch of the election.
2022 is one of the most challenging election cycles for Democrats in recent history. Mitch McConnell and national Republicans are sparing no expense in their effort to unseat me – spending more than $25 million on vicious attack ads. And that number will only go up.
That's why it's so important we keep up our momentum.

subject: Liz Cheney signs multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbanbk41v0ci4nb5ppkleubso1ct434n0bt4afjg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8or0c1gj8d5hmjpqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65s5hm2q3dd34epq32d3nckq66ppicoqb6phge2q6aclgc5ibeddgsgom6tbl6lo6fkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p32pjimsqj1ptiedj35c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvoj4funql5e6dkot3anbbbg6q4cigce58jhs9ko_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl2686080ds9uognrhckkp53795bmk2gf9tetheg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z817vat4cnmhign422n9vpuse0obhdu9pbagc87g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2za9kbjd4j5skj9coh82d0e5ahe1hpqekncr2nii8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z15q5smev0gllohe5usvu21hrqbvtvpj6hdori1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zt6sk7j1hjkptifa6h7v11dmr0gmemjfktbhajl8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember – Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zn8bubeej3akgnj0bhsamjdhefjpinf7djklt28o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs) [DONATE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zneb2qilb18o32hr9sjolkrjpomjh14n6sdt99do_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sjge8or6cjh2bs)

clean_body: | | | Peter, It’s time to sound the alarm on Washington politicians. Congress is failing because it’s filled with too many lawyers, lobbyists, and fame chasers. The DC swamp has the wrong kind of experience \- and I’m on a mission to change that. My name is Col. Mike Waltz. I’m the first and only U.S. Army Green Beret in Congress. And I know from both my time on and off the battlefield that no one gets the job done like America’s service members and veterans. Most members of Congress don’t know what it’s like to push your body to the limit and take on terrorists face to face, Peter. Most of them have never made an oath to give their life for their country, and most of them haven’t had their crew members’ lives in their hands. We need a new generation of leaders in Washington: servant leaders. Leaders who TRULY put service to their country before serving themselves. No one knows the spirit of service like America’s veterans, Peter. But right now, there’s a record low number of veterans in Congress. And right now, we need American heroes more than ever. Team, Kansas is proof of the power of organizing.

Last week, Kansans shut down any questions about where they stand on abortion rights. In a _landslide_ victory on Tuesday, voters from across the political spectrum voted to protect abortion access, defeating a constitutional amendment that would have paved the way to a total abortion ban in the state.

I applaud the organizers and activists in Kansas who fought tooth and nail for freedom. It shouldn't matter _where_ you live. Everyone deserves access to a full spectrum of reproductive health care in their own community.

I have been consistent on this issue my _entire life_ , because women deserve a choice and freedom. Period. My opponent has openly supported anti-abortion Republican lawmakers and has donated hundreds of thousands of dollars to their causes. He's a life-long, former Republican, who registered as a Democrat just weeks before filing for this election.

**Angelenos deserve better. That's why today, I'm asking you to take action.**

**[Stand with me in support of our most vulnerable, in support of privacy, choice, and authentic representation. Peter, We both know I don’t look like a typical politician. Maybe that’s why my tattoos are *literally* the first thing people Google about me. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqcJuDX2HRji8zceUQ74uMMFuugw7ry7TO3Ka63_iyz0I1FNi9wWyRTeWSlCwaeBPRDirBg28jFEDSoRcu8vwvm8UiNc-W_eLf8Yz_gprKvPxIpKEPBdKFpjwdmINHoLkUA_4psi0DM0HtO9mQJ653l8AKQcm0g_DSXsZgNkgu1TbJ6BcuSW5Dj5bI1JGWYvyHDx5B4oBvBg9X4uWzAKQkTHbaxlfRVqRV0iPozNZmCGbVCMAIbhC_911dxI9R01_9BSSqV_qpcQUtlTT1j51nNHSgzOlI8ex_cehNYVMptQ/3of/sTwWyOJqSNGlT3Tsa0us0g/h1/KqNokBpu7kSnKAKIQ_O9T0BnV6zIuNSPtLBbUhCTJM0) Well enough Googling. **Today I’ll tell you about my tattoos myself, Peter.** **On my left arm I have the zip code 15104.** That’s Braddock, Pennsylvania, my home and the community I was honored to serve as Mayor for 15 years. Gisele and I are raising our kids here in Braddock, right across the street from Andrew Carnegie’s first steel mill. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqcJuDX2HRji8zceUQ74uMMFuugw7ry7TO3Ka63_iyz0I1FNi9wWyRTeWSlCwaeBNrVSNV-oBPfAsOh0H-1sOkM25Mw7ywqO1jIODFnQtLLM_k5vIkXB5aD6ogd3HLPRS2U13DzvXfVN3G5RJhxObqcD3AYuVf9e8dxneoPbdevxYSyMJYNFdPYkxy3jx0pZmvodWQuddisIKxMLj7GlOOSLTYrIc7I7ulFrWKIZVqesJrrScCBR5CO5X_xakIPGYAp_G5lL-90bvln2i_7n7aIljcIkRHgVlrZo83vkwaRQ/3of/sTwWyOJqSNGlT3Tsa0us0g/h2/16CBEywyZcvwYUrpJTzdvhgG5SRNNDU6Bt3MCWluIgo) **On my right arm I have nine different dates.** These represent the dates of people who were killed through violence in Braddock while I served as Mayor, starting in 2005. Seven out of nine were gun deaths. I actually have to get one more date added because in June of 2018, there was another tragic loss of life. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqcJuDX2HRji8zceUQ74uMMFuugw7ry7TO3Ka63_iyz0I1FNi9wWyRTeWSlCwaeBPGHTs86ljxTldrinphVY7B9Kb8wWqkrpRgv5kCj1DJTBzaI7mqv7DejqjFtDwUGwHbB207-J1KktBwR_1TT8C44yVITCGo5t-Hu8IbBvBo8YC-x3X46t5kIb6bgjl6dfcQl2pLXgKgdlHuv5UMNrK9m5xv8GbgfhzhnpBEJVWLBJUC3z9kOcbJZl6SDL5WMCmcy_SykDfrFxUMRfFW3uV_QRrELZXxKyJzP3zqpXKCKQ/3of/sTwWyOJqSNGlT3Tsa0us0g/h3/1K58SzdHadFCa_FHKXplchfR3gf-bEXGVNtdvQP8c3A) My first tattoo came after January 16, 2006. It was my second week on the job as mayor after winning my election by a single vote. I received a call and was summoned to a police crime scene where a pizza delivery man had been robbed and killed by gun violence. **Every time Braddock lost someone was the worst feeling in the world.** In a close-knit community like Braddock, it’s very likely that you know the victim and their family. It’s an incredibly wrenching and personal experience as a mayor — but nothing compared to what the families have to go through. In my 13 years as Mayor, I worked with the community to take on gun violence and other important issues that Braddock faced every day. I helped initiate youth and art programs for the students of our community and we worked together to create a community center. We also worked to develop buildings that had been written off, kick-started our economy, and reduced deadly violence. My proudest moment as Mayor of Braddock is when our community went 5 1⁄2 years without the loss of life due to gun violence. **Peter, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I believe that every community is worth fighting for. Just like Braddock.** It is my promise to you that I'll fight for you + your community as if it were my very own. That promise is written on my arms. Literally. clean_body: I’m going to tell you about my tattoos. | | | Peter, We both know I don’t look like a typical politician. Maybe that’s why my tattoos are literally the first thing people Google about me. Well enough Googling. Today I’ll tell you about my tattoos myself, Peter. On my left arm I have the zip code 15104. That’s Braddock, Pennsylvania, my home and the community I was honored to serve as Mayor for 15 years. Gisele and I are raising our kids here in Braddock, right across the street from Andrew Carnegie’s first steel mill. On my right arm I have nine different dates. These represent the dates of people who were killed through violence in Braddock while I served as Mayor, starting in 2005. Seven out of nine were gun deaths. I actually have to get one more date added because in June of 2018, there was another tragic loss of life. My first tattoo came after January 16, 2006. It was my second week on the job as mayor after winning my election by a single vote. I received a call and was summoned to a police crime scene where a pizza delivery man had been robbed and killed by gun violence. Every time Braddock lost someone was the worst feeling in the world. In a close-knit community like Braddock, it’s very likely that you know the victim and their family. It’s an incredibly wrenching and personal experience as a mayor — but nothing compared to what the families have to go through. In my 13 years as Mayor, I worked with the community to take on gun violence and other important issues that Braddock faced every day. I helped initiate youth and art programs for the students of our community and we worked together to create a community center. We also worked to develop buildings that had been written off, kick-started our economy, and reduced deadly violence. My proudest moment as Mayor of Braddock is when our community went 5 1⁄2 years without the loss of life due to gun violence. Peter, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because I believe that every community is worth fighting for. Just like Braddock. It is my promise to you that I'll fight for you + your community as if it were my very own. That promise is written on my arms. Literally. We’re building the kind of Democratic U.S. Senate campaign that can flip Pennsylvania blue + fight for every community, however, the honest truth is that we need to raise a lot of money right now. A big part of that is online activists like you chipping in when you can. So, I gotta ask: Thanks for all you do, John John Fetterman Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: "What's wrong? Where does it hurt most?"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
Nurses have asked patients these questions countless times, Peter.
| | |
---
"What's wrong? Where does it hurt most?"
Nurses have asked patients these questions countless times, Peter. As a pediatric nurse, it was my job to listen to the children who came to our hospital and to figure out what we call their "chief complaint," or the reason why they ended up in my exam room that day.
Today, I'm reaching out to you with a similar question. From hateful partisanship to families struggling to put food on the table, America is hurting.
**And just like I helped children heal from broken bones and deep cuts, I'm running for Senate to heal a broken Washington and bridge the deep divides pulling our neighbors and communities apart.**
Far too many lawyers in Washington care more about lecturing than listening. They dive into legislating without taking time to hear from the people they're supposed to serve**. But as I learned from my long shifts as a nurse and the thousands of patients who I treated, you can't solve a problem or heal a wound without listening to the person who's in pain.**
So that's why I'm emailing you today. I know that your family is hurting in some way. **And whether it's over the rollback of abortion rights, the opioid epidemic that's ripping our communities apart, or an eviction notice on your door, I want to hear from you.** **[So please, will you take just a moment to tell me a little about the problems facing your family, and what you think leaders in Washington need to focus on to heal our country? Hearing from you will really mean so much to me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48955982/360238576/1980607770?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk183-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTgwMDgzMy00YTE3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=77bQPHCIW1IOSkHehTWMG_IMYIZTEd9RDisSh0nRUvE=&emci=40dc4eeb-4517-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=45800833-4a17-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**

clean_body: Nurses have asked patients these questions countless times, Peter. | | | "What's wrong? Where does it hurt most?" Nurses have asked patients these questions countless times, Peter. As a pediatric nurse, it was my job to listen to the children who came to our hospital and to figure out what we call their "chief complaint," or the reason why they ended up in my exam room that day. Today, I'm reaching out to you with a similar question. From hateful partisanship to families struggling to put food on the table, America is hurting. And just like I helped children heal from broken bones and deep cuts, I'm running for Senate to heal a broken Washington and bridge the deep divides pulling our neighbors and communities apart. Far too many lawyers in Washington care more about lecturing than listening. They dive into legislating without taking time to hear from the people they're supposed to serve. But as I learned from my long shifts as a nurse and the thousands of patients who I treated, you can't solve a problem or heal a wound without listening to the person who's in pain. So that's why I'm emailing you today. I know that your family is hurting in some way. And whether it's over the rollback of abortion rights, the opioid epidemic that's ripping our communities apart, or an eviction notice on your door, I want to hear from you. | | I'm so grateful to have you on my team, and I look forward to reading through your responses. Warmly, Trudy | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. subject: Will you help me fire Pelosi’s #1 Republican ally?
body:
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6224%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=KcrOKrllywl%2fHImtUeKL1Q&sysid=1)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64355%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bpBIS6C4JBfK244JqaVMLw&sysid=1)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney - who lives in Northern Virginia - Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate - they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers - including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner - who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right - even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64356%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KfAWCL%2bMF6w0uTVGykihlg&sysid=1)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64357%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CNCGL8KWD6yIWeUc2NsCmw&sysid=1)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64358%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fFohOhIj3Cxsmv8knHJD8w&sysid=1)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64359%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MvwiRCTPpbKdH%2fMwHJVzMA&sysid=1) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64350%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XWsGoxE419ovh%2fHlhwIbdQ&sysid=1)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember - Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64351%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fwqv%2fpevzEd8M6uSCUMQFw&sysid=1) [DONATE](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64352%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pSZcgXCYVrpq3Qc6DTFRIA&sysid=1)

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since. Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us. It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too. I'm also: 100% Pro-Life A strong supporter of our Second Amendment Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity A believer in our fight for election integrity Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending! My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: Not joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans! As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race. With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going. Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days. Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand \--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state. My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something. And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support. Respectfully, Harriet Hageman America First Conservative for Congress (WY) PS: Remember - Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me. | | Paid for by: Hageman For Wyoming P.O. Box 4157 Cheyenne, WY 82003 107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314

This is a victory for Coloradans and for the American people over corporate special interests and the status quo. The bill will lower costs for families at the pharmacy, at the gas pump, and on their monthly energy bills and health insurance premiums. And now, we’re one step closer to energy independence and leading the fight against climate change. Here’s what the IRA will do:
* **_Lower prescription drug and health care costs_** , by allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices — and cap prescription drug costs for seniors at $2,000 a year. Julia from Denver told me that her dad has a heart condition, and he pays $6,000 a month for medication — that’s $72,000 a year for something he needs to take for the rest of his life. That’s outrageous and ends with this bill.
* **_Build a fairer tax code_** by making sure the 200 biggest corporations that report over $1 billion in profit pay their fair share. Colorado teachers, firefighters and police officers shouldn’t be paying more in taxes than Amazon. It’s no wonder most Americans think our tax code is rigged. This comes directly from a bill I helped write.
* **_Make a historic investment in climate and clean energy_** — that includes $4 billion to address droughts in the West and the Colorado River Basin and $5 billion to restore the health of our forests and prevent wildfires. This bill will boost American manufacturing for wind, solar, and batteries to power electric vehicles and our energy grid. When you put it all together, this bill will put us on track to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 40% by the end of the decade.

For decades, Washington’s economic agenda has been pretty simple: Let the big corporations do whatever they want and call it “freedom;” slash investments in working families, and cut taxes for the wealthiest individuals. That left us with income inequality higher than any time since the 1920s and a country that charges families more for health care than most industrialized nations — where seniors are forced to cut their pills in half or skip their prescriptions. We’re left with a nation that is still shackled to a global fossil fuel market dictated by tyrants like Vladimir Putin, despite our abundant resources at home and the urgent threat of climate change. **With this bill, we are showing that government can deliver for working people, not the wealthy and big corporations.** I’m more hopeful than ever that we can leave Colorado and our country better for the next generation and build an economy that grows for everyone. # It's time to VOTE!
Alas, the time is upon us. It is hard to believe that we have finally reached Election Day! It has been an incredible journey, meeting so many wonderful people, hearing touching stories, all in the name of trying to expand veteran’s benefits, improve mental health coverage, and improve education. Tomorrow is the day we have been waiting for, August 9th! I suppose no longer will I be going around telling people to mark their calendars for the ninth. I have a direct ask of you, in addition to voting, please share our story with friends and people you know within the district. On my Facebook page I have pinned at the top a short 20 second video, talking about our core principles and our desire to have representation that is of the people. If each one of us could find 3-5 people to influence and get out to the voting booth, we can make a difference!Thank you to my entire staff, words cannot describe how much your hard work has meant on this journey! Attached are a couple highlights of the past week, including an endorsement by the College Republicans! We’ve had stops at the County Fairs, Beaver Dam Race Track, Sheboygan Brat Fest Parade, Lakeshore Chinooks, and more!

disclaimer_text: Paid for by James Judge for Congress
body:
The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary race, James Judge, has earned the endorsement of the Pinellas County Sheriff. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1ff2fedefdf2/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13684592?e=00028e5542)
---
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=cd5e13e68c&e=00028e5542)
[**FL-14 frontrunner James Judge endorsed by Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=7850f44a32&e=00028e5542)
_The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary race, James Judge, has earned the endorsement of the Pinellas County Sheriff._ TAMPA, Fla. – The Republican Primary frontrunner in Florida’s 14th Congressional District James Judge has earned the endorsement of Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, the Judge campaign announced Monday.Gualtieri’s endorsement is the second major law enforcement endorsement Judge has received, after being endorsed by the Tampa Police Benevolent Association in June. A major focal point of Judge’s campaign has been backing law enforcement, as congressional Democrats sponsored legislation to defund the police and make enforcing laws more difficult.“I’ve met with James, seen him engaging with the community and respect his strong support for protecting our brave law enforcement officers,” Gualtieri said. “It’s a challenging time to be a member of the law enforcement community, and Democrat sponsored legislation has without question made our communities less safe. I’m confident James will do what he can to help put an end to bad laws that hamper effective policing. He has my complete support in his race to be the next Congressman for Florida’s 14th Congressional district.”Judge humbly accepted the endorsement.“I’m beyond grateful for Sheriff Gualtieri’s support, and the support of our brave men and women who put on the uniform every day to selflessly serve others,” said Judge. “One of the reasons I entered this race was because I have been disgusted by the utter disrespect for our police and the rule of law coming from the political left. They burned down cities over the death of a felon – who then received a nationally televised funeral – and Democrats responded by saying we need less police. It was beyond disgraceful.”“Kathy Castor has outwardly expressed her disdain for police,” said Judge. “She wants to make our city and the district less safe, and she demonizes those who bravely serve our community. I won’t stand for it. The answer is more support for our law enforcement officers, not less.”Sheriff Gualtieri’s endorsement is another in a long line of endorsements earned by Judge.Judge’s campaign continues to gain momentum while he meets with voters in the district and garners endorsements from local and national figures.Judge recently earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times, and has been endorsed by Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, the Community Patriots Tampa, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.
