body:
Make sure you know how to take care of yourself and your loved ones this summer.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220808-3282-header&t=1&akid=3282%2E2526796%2ERrTTjy)
We’re sure you’ve noticed these last few weeks have made for an especially uncomfortable summer in NYC, the rest of the country, and all over the world. Make no mistake, skyrocketing global temperatures are a result of the climate crisis, and we can expect these extreme weather conditions to worsen.
So, here at Team AOC, we want to make sure you know how to stay safe this summer from heat stroke and other health effects of heat:
**Get creative with hydration.**
It doesn’t just have to be water! Juices and electrolyte-infused drinks will help replace some of the energy lost in your sweat. You can even add DIY electrolytes to your beverages at home with this recipe from 350.org: Mix together:
\- 1/4 cup lemon juice
\- 2 tbsp lime juice
\- 2 tbsp raw honey
\- 1/8 tsp of sea salt
\- 2 cups of cold water
**If you don’t have A/C, cover your windows with curtains or sheets – better yet, damp sheets.**
The curtains will block the sun’s rays from further heating up your home, and the moisture in the fabric will cool down whatever air is flowing in from outside. This is an important tip from heat wave researcher Gulrez Shah Azhar — who grew up in Uttar Pradesh, India without A/C — in an article for NPR (read more [**here**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14811?t=2&akid=3282%2E2526796%2ERrTTjy)).
**Mist yourself with cool water, or place a wet towel around the back of your neck.**
Azhar also attests to how important it is to lower the temperature of your skin with moisture and breezes whenever possible. Soaking your feet in cool water will help lower that temp too!
**Check on your neighbors.**
Are the elders and unhoused in your neighborhood struggling to keep themselves cool? Post these tips in your lobby and knock on your neighbors’ doors to check in. Offer water and damp towels to the unhoused. Communities keep each other safe!
**Keep the larger climate fight in mind.**
If corporations and establishment politicians are going to continue to prioritize profit over protecting vulnerable communities, it’s up to us to educate and protect our neighbors from the dangers of extreme heat - which we know disproportionately affects lower-income communities and marginalized people.
It’s no secret as to why portions of The Bronx have the highest rates of childhood asthma in the country. As temperatures climb and air quality suffers, we have to stick together to fight these devastating health outcomes.
The climate crisis may be global, but Alexandria firmly believes that coordinated action at a local level is the best community protection money can’t buy.
Stay cool,
Team AOC

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Senate Democrats pass the Inflation Reduction Act
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
It’s the country’s biggest investment in fighting climate change ever.
#
Peter, after more than a year of negotiations, I am thrilled that Senate Democrats passed a bill containing major parts of the Build Back Better agenda.
The Inflation Reduction Act is the country’s biggest investment in fighting climate change ever. $369 billion will go towards clean energy technology and reducing carbon emissions by 40% by 2030. The bill will lower energy costs and provide subsidies to folks for electric vehicles and renewable energy home updates.
We also empower Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices, which will lower Rx costs. We extend critical subsidies for millions of folks with health insurance through the Affordable Care Act. And we begin to ensure that the wealthiest Americans and the biggest corporations pay their fair share of taxes.
**We would not have won the progressive policies in the bill without our hard work advocating for the people.** The Congressional Progressive Caucus has been a key part of the push for this bill, and our work is paying off. Progressives in Congress and in the movement held the line and demanded action on these priorities. Even up against the GOP, Big Pharma, and corporate lobbyists, we kept fighting.
**Now, we need to pass this bill in the House. And, as Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, I will continue my fight to secure these wins for the people.**
[**Peter, can you chip in $3 to fuel my advocacy for this historic bill? We have a chance to bring home major wins for the people on climate, health care, and taxing the rich.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/15696?refcode=em20220808-1496&t=1&akid=1496%2E420207%2EBGmg4x)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/15696?refcode=em20220808-1496&t=20&akid=1496%2E420207%2EBGmg4x)**
This is another major step towards using our Democratic majorities and President Biden in the White House to deliver for the people. We did it with the American Rescue Plan and infrastructure spending, and we can do it again with the Inflation Reduction Act.
Not every one of our policies made it into this bill, which means I won’t only be fighting to pass this bill, but I’ll be working to strengthen our majority in Congress so we have two more years of legislating for progressive change.
I will keep you updated as we work towards passing this historic piece of legislation through the House.
In solidarity,
Pramila

body:
| | |
---
Just hours ago, we learned that agents of the Federal Bureau of Investigation today raided President Trump’s home at Mar-a-Lago. This unprecedented and shocking action, outrageous as it is, should not be surprising. Under President Biden, the Democrats’ corruption, weaponization, and politicization of the agencies of the federal government has reached new lows. In response, I issued the [following statement](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NjQwJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/YX3w8xnNiYzHMdWgP5qrkA):
---
| | “Joe Biden must be impeached. The raid on President Trump’s home should have never happened. It is beyond wrong. It is obviously part of the ongoing witch hunt that began before President Trump ever took office, and which continues to this day. “President Obama’s IRS unlawfully targeted citizen groups that dared to oppose Obama policies. Now President Biden’s FBI and DOJ have continued the tradition of politicizing federal agencies and have upped the ante by attacking a former president. “We are supposed to be a constitutional republic not a banana republic. This madness must be stopped. “Anyone and everyone who cares about the future of our constitutional republic must get out to vote in record numbers in the fall elections. We must elect a Congress that will use its constitutional oversight and power of the purse to rein in an out-of-control executive and return power to the people.”
---
| | In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin
Honorary Chairman, Tea Party Patriots Action

This evening, I’m remembering why I entered this race. Last fall, as our state came out of a once-in-a-century pandemic, I faced an important decision – do I step up, or do I sit on the sidelines? I chose to step up, because the challenges facing our state are enormous, from our housing and workforce shortages to our lack of paid family and medical leave. I know these challenges because like so many Vermonters, I’ve lived them. I’ve had to work two jobs to pay the rent. I know what it's like to care for a loved one without paid leave. As Lieutenant Governor, I’ve seen how climate change has impacted family farms like the one I grew up on. **I stepped up because our greatest challenges cannot be solved by Vermont alone.** This moment requires a congresswoman who will work with anyone — regardless of party — to do what’s best for Vermont. We need a congresswoman with the skills and experience to defend our fundamental rights. **We need a congresswoman who will focus on getting results, not getting credit.** I will serve in Congress the same way I’ve served as Lieutenant Governor and run this campaign: by listening, leading with civility, and meeting Vermonters where they are. It remains the honor of my life to serve as Vermont's Lieutenant Governor, and every day on the campaign trail I fall more in love with this state. As I prepare for tomorrow, I want to recognize that this campaign would not have been possible without all of you – our supporters, volunteers, and campaign team. This campaign has made over 300,000 calls, texts, and door-knocks. We’ve talked to tens of thousands of Vermonters – in backyards, at general stores, on front porches, and everywhere in between. We know we have the support to win tomorrow. This bill is the largest climate bill in U.S. history and could supercharge America's transition to a clean economy. **Now we need House Democrats to pass this bill and get it on Biden's desk ASAP.[_Call your House representative right now and tell them to pass the Inflation Reduction Act!_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/call_reps_inflation_reduction_act/?utm_source=ema_2022-08-08_call_reps_inflation_reduction_act_&source=ema_2022-08-08_call_reps_inflation_reduction_act__&t=3&akid=13088%2E53494%2EYciboh)** | [CALL YOUR REP](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/call_reps_inflation_reduction_act/?utm_source=ema_2022-08-08_call_reps_inflation_reduction_act_&source=ema_2022-08-08_call_reps_inflation_reduction_act__&t=4&akid=13088%2E53494%2EYciboh)
---
This bill includes $369 billion for climate investments, including clean energy tax credits, environmental justice initiatives, and unprecedented federal investments that will save consumers money and reduce pollution—provisions that Evergreen helped shape with your support. It's the turning point we need in the fight for a livable future. At the same time, this bill is also a compromise. Unfortunately, Joe Manchin was able to insert some troubling provisions that will do real harm—particularly to communities in the Gulf Coast and Alaska. But let me be clear: **While this bill is a compromise, it must pass.**
As you know all too well, the 50-50 Senate has been the biggest obstacle to passing climate legislation. I can't overstate the significance of this news—for the first time ever, Congress is on track to fully pass game-changing investments in clean energy that will set us on track to cut pollution by roughly 40% by 2030.
But even though the Inflation Reduction Act has cleared the Senate, it's not a done deal yet. As we saw last year, there are some Democrats willing to obstruct popular legislation for special interests in the House, too. That's why we need to shore up support for this bill immediately.
[**_It starts with your representative hearing from you about why passing this bill is so important. Call them right now—we have a script ready for you_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/call/call_reps_inflation_reduction_act/?utm_source=ema_2022-08-08_call_reps_inflation_reduction_act_&source=ema_2022-08-08_call_reps_inflation_reduction_act__&t=5&akid=13088%2E53494%2EYciboh)

Friend,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Friend I your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $10 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Sincerely,
Anna with Team Lumaj
